style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, high mountain noon
motion_rule: EVERY second something big crosses the lens or fills it: a bill, her tail, the herd, the marmot's face, the paper blizzard. The lens is fully blanked seven times. Grass and valley dust never stop moving
camera_moves: wide; close-ups are brought by the animals and the paper, not the camera
character: a lean mountain puma on a flat rock, half-closed golden eyes, utterly calm, a neat stack of pale paper bills under one paw; she never hurries
cast: the MARMOT: fat, chewing without pause, never running; he tumbles into frame at the lens and fills half the screen. The HERD below: goats and deer, always at full speed
props: BILLS: pale paper slips, no letters or numbers, only a small embossed percent shape, each as big as her head. ROCK: one flat slab. Nothing is stacked on anything
prop_continuity: the stack under her paw shrinks all clip: full at 0.0, half at 4.2, gone at 8.0; one bill ends up flattened under the marmot
environment: sunlit mountain ledge, wind-raked dry grass, blue sky, dusty valley below
lighting: blazing high-altitude noon, hard sun, crisp shadows, high exposure

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: lazy satisfied female voice, calm, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: pauses only at 1.4-2.2, 3.6-4.2 and 7.0-7.5; the 4.2 and 5.6 lines run together with no breath; voiceless after 8.0, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: paper rustle on every bill, drumming hooves from the valley, wind in dry grass all clip, the marmot's steady chewing

timeline.a: silent. A bill the size of her head flies INTO THE LENS, blanks the whole frame, peels away to reveal her on the rock; the herd streaks below
she walks her whole body straight at the lens until her face fills the frame, eyes half shut, grass whipping past her
silent. She flicks a bill off the stack: it slaps against the lens, covers it completely, drops away to the valley; the herd surges
she turns her whole body around on the slab, the tail sweeping right across the lens and blanking it once
silent. The fat MARMOT tumbles down into frame at the lens, his chewing face filling half the screen, kicking a spray of bills up across the whole frame
she rises to her feet in one long body stretch while the wind tears half the stack into a paper blizzard over the whole frame
no breath. The herd tears through the frame edge to edge in a wall of dust, and she swings her head round to follow it
silent, the only stop in the clip. Nothing moves but the marmot's jaw at the lens and one bill settling onto the rock
she whips her head into the lens, muzzle filling the frame, golden eyes opening wide for the first time
silent. She sweeps the whole remaining stack over the edge with one paw; the paper packs the lens solid
silent. The last sheets whirl past the lens and clear: the marmot has flattened one bill, drops onto it sideways and shuts his eyes; her tail crosses the frame and dust settles

must_appear: bills blanking the lens, the herd always at full speed, the MARMOT never running, the stack shrinking to nothing, the marmot asleep on a bill at the end
negative_prompt: letters, numbers, cyrillic, logos, readable text on the bills, subtitles, watermark, coins, night, dusk, dark scene, dim light, people, hands, a second puma, slow motion, speed ramp, the herd standing still, the puma frozen through a whole beat, any voice from her after 8.0, silence in the tail, accented Russian, drawn-out delivery, grain
